pressItems.title: TalentPool365 passes two million AI interviews a year
pressItems.summary: Hiring teams in 40 countries now run structured first-round interviews on the platform, with a recruiter making every decision.

pressItems.title: Conversational AI interviews now available in twelve languages
pressItems.summary: The interviewer asks follow-up questions drawn from each answer while staying inside the question plan a panel has approved.

pressItems.title: Quarterly bias audit results published to all customers
pressItems.summary: The latest audit covers screening, assessments and interviews, and is shared unedited alongside the method used.

pressItems.title: WhatsApp applications and scheduling launch for volume hiring
pressItems.summary: Candidates for retail, manufacturing and contact centre roles can apply, book interviews and sign offers inside one chat.

pressItems.title: TalentPool365 achieves SOC 2 Type II certification
pressItems.summary: The independent audit covers security, availability and confidentiality. The company also published its EU AI Act alignment.
